title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a manuscript note on the divided-power de Rham complex. It is a typed page of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX (Grothendieck, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), p. 121, the opening of §10, 'Propriétés de l'accouplement de monodromie. Théorème d'intégrité et de positivité'. Its subject has nothing to do with the neighbouring pages, which concern the complex C^{**} and S_k. The page seems to have been interleaved into cote 136.

Setting. K is the fraction field of a henselian DVR with base S. A_K is an abelian variety over K with dual A'_K, and A, A' are their Néron models.

In §9 Grothendieck attaches to (S, A_K, A'_K) a monodromy pairing (9.1.2), u_ℓ^{A_K} : M_ℓ ⊗ M'_ℓ → Z_ℓ. Here M_ℓ and M'_ℓ are the ℓ-adic realizations of the character groups of the toric parts of the special fibres of the Néron models. The pairing comes from the variation of the Tate modules under inertia, via the semistable reduction / orthogonality theorem and the Weil pairing.

This page states two formal properties:
- 10.1: the pairing is compatible with transport of structure, i.e. it is functorial for isomorphisms of the data (S, A_K, A'_K).
- 10.2 (symmetry): apply the construction to A'_K and identify (A'_K)' with A_K by biduality (ref. [5], i.e. Cartier/Oda-type duality, or VIII 3.2). The pairing u_ℓ^{A'_K} : M'_ℓ ⊗ M_ℓ → Z_ℓ is then u_ℓ^{A_K} composed with the switch s. The formula itself falls on the next typescript page.

The introduction announces the deeper Theorem 10.4. The pairing is integral, i.e. it comes from a Z-valued pairing M ⊗ M' → Z on the character groups. For a polarization it gives a positive-definite form. The proof reduces to a special case of Jacobians, treated transcendentally in §12, which is stated to be logically independent of §11.
errors: No mathematical error on the page. The verifications are explicitly left to the reader.
Sign conventions in the symmetry formula depend on the conventions for the Weil pairing and for biduality. The page does not show the formula, so this cannot be checked here.
Archival note: this typed SGA 7 page appears misfiled or interleaved within the manuscript notes on the divided-power de Rham complex.

ideas.what: Monodromy pairing for an abelian variety with semistable reduction, between character groups of the tori of A and its dual

deep.surprise_reason: This is a page of the published SGA 7 I Exposé IX typescript. Every statement on it is in the published literature and credited to Grothendieck. The only curiosity is archival: the page is interleaved in a later folder on divided-power de Rham complexes.
transcription_corrections: 'nous devons introduire le schéma dual (A'_K)' de A_K' should read '(A'_K)' de A'_K'. On the page, the subscript after 'de' is ambiguous. Mathematically it is the dual of A'_K, canonically isomorphic to A_K.
M_ℓ and M'_ℓ are underlined (underline notation) in the typescript.
The duplicated '439' is the archive stamp (handwritten and printed). '115' is the folder page number. Neither is part of the text.
